rationale: Playbook PG-EXF-001 matched on alert ALRT-0013. The principal carol.tan@eproc.test operating as database role dba read 1 statements against public.employees between 2026-08-12T20:00:00Z and 2026-08-12T20:12:00Z. The standing playbook for bulk sensitive reads revokes the read grant that was used, terminates the live backend, and preserves the statement sample for the investigator.
rollback:
GRANT SELECT ON public.employees TO dba;
DELETE FROM incident_hold WHERE alert_id = 'ALRT-0013';

alert_summary.rule_name: Unbounded read of sensitive employee or vendor columns

evidence.statement: SELECT employee_id, department, position, salary FROM employees
SELECT department, avg(salary)::numeric(12,2) FROM employees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

baseline_context.note: Role dba normally returns about 372 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
